description: Creates a one-time SlabLineage upload link (valid 30 minutes) for an AI-powered pre-grade of a raw Pokémon or One Piece card. Open the link to take the two photos; the result then appears in my_pregrades. Uses the account's daily pre-grade allowance.

cardId.description: SlabLineage card id of the raw card (the number in https://slablineage.com/card/{id}).

name: start_pregrade
title: Start a pre-grade
